newsitem.title: USA: United Retail held by Cumberland Associates.
newsitem.headline: United Retail held by Cumberland Associates.

text.p: Cumberland Associates, a New York-based investment adviser, said Monday it holds a 5.3 percent stake or 640,000 common shares in United Retail Group Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Cumberland said it paid about $4.9 million for the stake and holds it for investment.
It said the stake includes 225,000 shares purchased between November 5 and December 9 at prices ranging from $2.00 to $2.9375 a share.
Cumberland said it holds the stake for investment.
